correctness.rationale: Direct graph definition uniquely reconstructs all 25 stable vertices, 60 graph edges, and 19,907 faces. The exhaustive ordinary matching has 9,951 pairs and critical-cell distribution 1x0+1x3+2x4; its complete oriented Hasse incidence DAG has no cycle (110,730 augmented incidences checked). Signed exact integer Morse boundary coefficients from the critical four-cells to the critical three-cell are [0,0]. Degree classification \(\pi_3(S^3)\cong\mathbb Z\) therefore yields the stated wedge. Separately implemented mod-two rank elimination gives \(\beta_0=1,\beta_3=1,\beta_4=2\). Scripts verify finite exhaustive statements, no asymptotic claim.

value.rationale: Braun 2009 explicitly singled out Ind(SG(n,2)) as having difficult unknown homotopy despite completing SG(2,k) and auxiliary E families. SG(4,2) is a canonical 25-vertex case of that natural family; its mixed-dimensional homotopy wedge is not a trivial graph rephrasing. Integral vanishing of both attaching maps is a nontrivial homotopy datum not determined by the cell counts or mod-two Betti numbers alone. Reproducible exact finite case can serve as a benchmark and guides further inquiry without asserting any general theorem.
